data-quality.name: Data quality assertions
data-quality.description: Check completeness, uniqueness, freshness, and referential integrity, and quarantine or reject records that violate defined rules.

data-warehousing.name: Dimensional modeling and slowly changing dimensions
data-warehousing.description: Define fact-table grain, conformed dimensions, and historical attribute changes with tests for joins and aggregate correctness.

stream-processing.name: Event-time windows and late data handling
stream-processing.description: Process streams using event-time windows, watermarks, deduplication, and policies for late events and replay.

data-lineage.name: Dataset lineage and impact analysis
data-lineage.description: Trace source-to-output dataset dependencies and use column or table lineage to assess the impact of schema and transformation changes.

advanced-sql.name: SQL window functions and CTEs
advanced-sql.description: Build transformations using window functions, common table expressions, and joins, then inspect query plans for correctness and cost.

batch-ingestion.name: Batch data ingestion
batch-ingestion.description: Import data from databases, files, and APIs with checkpoints and repeatable execution.

data-file-formats.name: Columnar file schemas and partitioning
data-file-formats.description: Read and write columnar datasets with explicit schemas, compression, and partition layouts, and validate compatibility across readers.

object-storage.name: Object storage
object-storage.description: Organize and secure durable object storage for raw and processed datasets.

pipeline-idempotency.name: Idempotent data processing
pipeline-idempotency.description: Make pipeline retries and reprocessing safe without duplicating records or corrupting results.

workflow-scheduling.name: Workflow scheduling
workflow-scheduling.description: Define dependency-aware schedules, retries, timeouts, and backfill policies for data jobs.

data-transformations.name: Data transformation workflows
data-transformations.description: Build reusable transformations with tested business rules and documented inputs and outputs.

schema-evolution.name: Schema evolution
schema-evolution.description: Introduce source and output schema changes without silently breaking downstream consumers.

incremental-processing.name: Incremental data processing
incremental-processing.description: Process changed records efficiently while handling watermarks, late updates, and deletes.

change-data-capture.name: Change data capture
change-data-capture.description: Capture database changes and propagate inserts, updates, and deletes to downstream systems.

lakehouse-storage.name: Data lake and lakehouse storage
lakehouse-storage.description: Organize analytical storage around partitioned tables, metadata, and reliable table updates.

distributed-data-processing.name: Distributed data processing
distributed-data-processing.description: Partition large computations and handle skew, shuffles, and failures across workers.

data-catalogs.name: Data catalogs and metadata
data-catalogs.description: Document dataset ownership, schemas, definitions, and discoverability in shared catalogs.

data-contracts.name: Data contracts
data-contracts.description: Agree on schema, quality, freshness, and compatibility expectations between data producers and consumers.

data-access-governance.name: Data access governance
data-access-governance.description: Control dataset access using ownership, classification, and least-privilege policies.

pipeline-observability.name: Data pipeline observability
pipeline-observability.description: Monitor freshness, volume, failures, and end-to-end pipeline health.

data-platform-architecture.name: Data platform architecture
data-platform-architecture.description: Design ingestion, storage, transformation, and serving layers around workload and ownership needs.

data-retention.name: Data retention and deletion
data-retention.description: Apply retention and deletion workflows consistently across source, derived, and archived datasets.

data-serving.name: Analytical data serving
data-serving.description: Deliver trusted datasets through warehouse tables, extracts, or interfaces matched to consumer needs.

data-recovery.name: Data replay and recovery
data-recovery.description: Restore trustworthy datasets through controlled replay, backfills, and reconciliation after failures.

data-platform-governance.name: Dataset ownership and compatibility policies
data-platform-governance.description: Define dataset owners, versioning rules, compatibility checks, and exception handling for shared data products.
